text.content:
Plague · Wasting · Surrender of the Body

Formed from a quarantine camp's dead — never buried, never quite silent, singing the same fever hymn until the voices stopped being separate. Grants plague-workers a grim resilience and the conviction that suffering, correctly aimed, means something. It will deal with anyone willing to get sick for a good enough reason, and asks only that the sickness be pointed at something.

Usable setting-wide as a petty-god patron for any class — the Fleshmancer is simply the one with a feat chain built to use it directly.
